how: Before the first M1 run, list the events you think the ending really depends on: a title in your own words and the chapter. Leave pool_id null. Once the pool exists, set pool_id to the id of the matching pool event, or leave it null if the pool doesn't have it.
provenance: Written after the reader had seen the first M1 pool (2026-10-12), so the picks may lean toward it and recall may read higher than an independent list would give.
reader_cuts_note: Events the judge kept that the reader would cut (2026-10-12, after the first 5 judge runs). The reader agreed with the judge's 8 cuts. Reader: 'all these events are factually significant to plot point, but they don't explain why Caleb is the way he is.'
reader_cuts_pool: m1-pool-1 (the archived plot pool); these ids are not in the current pool
reader_keeps_note: The reader's own picks from the m1-pool-2 pool (30 Cal-centered events), chosen after reading it and before any judge run on it (2026-10-12). Compare with the judge's consensus.
